walkthroughs.body_html:
Cells grow, copy DNA, then divide.

Stages: G1 grow, S phase (DNA copied), G2 grow more, then mitosis (PMAT) and cytokinesis. Two identical daughter cells.

Embryonic stem cells can form any cell type. Adult stem cells (e.g. bone marrow) form a limited range.

Edexcel asks you to evaluate uses — treating diabetes, paralysis, blood disorders — vs ethical and rejection concerns.

Stimulus → receptor → sensory neurone → CNS → motor neurone → effector → response.

A reflex skips the brain — it goes through the spinal cord via a relay neurone for speed.
